slides.title: Before you judge the morning, record it
slides.body: A broken night is context for today's decision. Not a score of your discipline.

slides.title: The night
slides.body:
When did you wake? 2–3am, 3–4am, 4–5am?
How long until you fell back asleep?

slides.title: Your fatigue right now
slides.body:
Heavy, moderate or low.
Plus one concrete detail: "getting dressed feels slow".

slides.title: Your willingness to move
slides.body: Separate from fatigue. You can be tired and still open to a gentle walk.

slides.title: Observation, not judgement
slides.body:
"Heavy fatigue, slow to get going" is information.
"I have no discipline" is not.

slides.title: Then the plan meets the day
slides.body:
The Morning Capacity Check turns these notes into one clear choice.

Link in bio.

story.title: Tired and unwilling to move are two different things.
story.body: Which one is it this morning?

frames.title: Pushing through can cost you the whole week.
There are more than two options.
Modified plan. Gentle movement. Deliberate rest.
